# Workshop admin scene illustrations

Generated on 2026-09-11 with the built-in image_gen tool. Seven independent scene generations used `web/public/images/workshop-welcome.webp` as strict character-identity reference. No external stock artwork or new dependencies. Original generated PNGs remain in the local Codex generated_images directory.

All outputs are 900 × 600 RGBA WebP, quality 88, method 6. Local background removal was explicitly authorized. A four-connected flood fill removes near-white background pixels (minimum RGB > 247, channel spread < 20), seeded from canvas borders plus enclosed handle/wrench/abacus openings. A 1-source-pixel alpha erosion and 0.35px feather remove pale edge fringe. Objects are centered with 10% total safe margin then Lanczos resized. Interior ceramic colors, dark eyes, handles, feet, and silver clasps are preserved. Both light (#f5f5f7) and dark (#161719) composites were produced; all seven dark composites were visually inspected at output resolution.

Users and tools initially received painted checkerboard / black glow backgrounds, so each received one additional background-only edit before local cutout. The final files contain real alpha, not a painted transparency pattern.
